metadata.analysis_scope: Same-Day Intraday Session Sequence & Transition (Day T: Asian -> London -> Overlap -> NY)

asian_to_london.takeaway: Near 50/50 split (uncorrelated -0.05). London opens with its own institutional order flow rather than following Asia's lead.

london_to_new_york.takeaway: Slight bias toward reversal (55% Reversal / 45% Continuation) due to NY profit-taking and US economic data reversals.

asian_range_breakout_dynamics.takeaway: In 73.64% of all trading days, London breaks out of the Asian boundary (liquidity sweep). In only 26.36% of days does London stay confined.

same_day_volatility_spillover.takeaway: Strong positive volatility clustering (0.4195 corr). A wider Asian morning range reliably signals an explosive afternoon overlap session.
